title: Inventory epilepsy burden, diagnosis, medicine-access, and primary-care cascade sources
outcome: A dated source inventory separating household surveys, facility and primary-care records, medicine-access surveys, procurement and stock data, registries, implementation studies, and unusable sources by the stage they can observe.
inputs: WHO Epilepsy fact sheet and global report
WHO Improving access to medicines for neurological disorders
household, facility, pharmacy, procurement, registry, and implementation-study candidates
expected_artifact: datasets.md update plus evidence.json records for each accepted source family.
validation_method: Domain reviewer checks every source for URL, source date, access date, case definition, numerator, denominator, event grain, time reference, accessibility, and explicit limitations; a second reviewer can reconstruct each classification from evidence.md.
done_condition: At least seven candidate source families are classified as usable, limited, or rejected with explicit reasons covering active-epilepsy denominator, diagnosis, medicine stock or dispensing, possession or adherence, seizure outcome, referral, geographic grain, and missingness.

title: Define stage-level measures for an epilepsy primary-care cascade
outcome: A reproducible measure dictionary separating active epilepsy, diagnosis, medicine initiation, refill continuity, possession or adherence, seizure control, follow-up, referral, and outcome.
inputs: WHO epilepsy definitions and neurological-medicine access framework
national case definitions and essential-medicine lists
expected_artifact: validation.md update with stage definitions, numerator and denominator rules, event timing, transfer handling, and missingness categories.
validation_method: Replicator maps each synthetic event to exactly one allowed stage or an explicit unknown category and confirms that policy, procurement, stock, dispensing, possession, adherence, and clinical outcome are not silently collapsed.
done_condition: A reviewer can reconstruct every cascade numerator and denominator from a de-identified sample and identify every excluded, duplicated, transferred, or missing event without using unknown as untreated.

title: Build one setting-specific epilepsy treatment-access cascade baseline
outcome: A documented baseline showing where a named epilepsy-care pathway loses observable episodes without issuing a treatment recommendation or country ranking.
inputs: de-identified setting-specific population, facility, medicine, and referral records
programme decision calendar and responsible user
expected_artifact: outputs.md baseline specification plus a rerunnable analysis artifact, input hash, and environment note.
validation_method: Replicator reruns the baseline from the documented input hash and environment, verifies every stage calculation, checks an alternative denominator definition, and confirms that conclusions remain within the observed setting.
done_condition: The baseline reports stage-specific denominators, missingness, selection boundaries, and uncertainty for one named setting, and a reviewer can identify the exact observation that would overturn the proposed bottleneck.

title: Red-team clinical, privacy, and allocation misuse of epilepsy cascade outputs
outcome: A failure-mode review covering diagnostic overreach, medicine interpretation, facility blame, inequitable ranking, missing-population bias, stigma, and privacy loss.
expected_artifact: outputs.md safety gate and a structured red-team review record.
validation_method: Red-team reviewer documents concrete misuse paths and a field-reality reviewer independently replicates the check, confirming whether each path has a mitigation or publication block.
done_condition: Every proposed programme-facing interpretation is blocked or has explicit safeguards against patient-level diagnosis, medicine or dose advice, denominator error, privacy loss, stigma, coercion, facility blame, and exclusion of people missing from records.

title: Check the epilepsy cascade artifact against a real programme decision
outcome: A field-facing review naming the responsible programme user, decision timing, data burden, referral path, appeal path, and non-use cases.
inputs: local epilepsy primary-care and referral workflow
expected_artifact: playbooks.md field-reality section update and a review record.
validation_method: Field-reality reviewer records one responsible use and one explicit non-use; a red-team reviewer independently replicates the governance check and confirms that the artifact does not bypass clinical, privacy, or equity safeguards.
done_condition: A named programme decision-maker can identify one responsible use, one non-use, the minimum evidence needed before acting, and how people omitted from the data are protected from adverse decisions.
